_comment: PHASE 5 acceptance thresholds. Numbers, not adjectives: the first review's
P2-3 point is that 'record the numbers' is not a gate, an allowed delta is.
A pack that cannot meet these is labelled partial/experimental in its
manifest rather than advertised as an identical conversion.
The 2026-07-26 1094x846 captures are DIAGNOSTICS, not a baseline: they
report 99.87% and 99.94% changed pixels, which means the capture sequence
was broken (one side sat on a menu), not that the packs are 99% wrong.

capture._resolutions_note: authored 4:3 plus 16:9; add ultrawide when a tester has one
capture._warmup_note: fonts and page textures must be resident before the shot, or the first frame diffs against itself
capture._stable_note: N identical consecutive frames before capturing, so animation never decides a result
preShotAssertions: serverTick / demo frame == the pinned value
maskedRegions: score digits that tick during capture
capture._masked_note: masked, not ignored: a diff INSIDE a mask is invisible, so masks stay as small as the moving text

visual._inside_note: 2% absorbs antialiasing and font hinting, not a moved or missing element
visual._outside_note: ZERO by design. A pixel changing outside every declared part box means the pack draws where it did not declare, which is a finding in itself and the thing per-part thresholds cannot catch

performance._baseline: the legacy config it converts, same scene, same resolution
performance._controls_note: a converted pack should retain FEWER controls than its legacy original, never more; >0 means a detach was missed

lifecycle._comment: counts must return to baseline after each cycle; a drift is a leak
